types.description: Schneider Electric Multi 9 C60N circuit breaker, 2P, curve C, 4 A

document.title: Schneider Electric Multi 9 — Interruttori C60N, Curve B e C (reproduced in Schede tecniche-R1)
document.revision: Undated municipal compilation; pages match Multi 9 Catalogo 2010–2011

modelingNotes: Exact 24266 row: C60N, 2P, curve C, 4 A; width four 9 mm steps. Manufacturer catalog printed p.15, 2P diagram E45094.

Terminal markings 1 and 3 above, 2 and 4 below; switched pole pairs 1–2 and 3–4. No phase, neutral or supply-direction assignment is inferred. Ganging is mechanical and creates no fixed electrical links.
Current rating 4 A at 30 °C; curve C magnetic operation 5–10 times In. Trip simulation and installation coordination are not modeled.

AC ratings on printed p.14: Ue 400 V; CEI EN 60898 Icn 6000 A at 400 V for 2P. CEI EN 60947-2 Icu 20 kA at 230–240 V and 10 kA at 400–415 V for 2P. Ui 500 V AC; Uimp 6 kV. Conditional capabilities are not assigned circuit voltage; nominal_voltage and voltage_type omitted.
Cage terminals: for In up to 25 A, conductor capacity up to 16 mm² flexible or 25 mm² rigid. This is not an automated conductor-sizing rule.

Bare breaker only; separately fitted auxiliary/release/residual-current accessories are outside this order model. No PE, shield or communication terminal is shown for this breaker. Connections are application-dependent, so none is universally required. Open contact state follows the catalog schematic, not an asserted operating state.
Manufacturer-authored pages at a municipal mirror; supplied catalog cover and pp.14–15 images were also visually inspected. Both pole functions use the existing breaker circuit symbol.

connectionCoverage.notes: Four main cage terminals 1, 2, 3, 4 in the applicable 2P diagram E45094. Scope is exact bare 24266 breaker; no accessory terminals or external bonding paths are included.
